#Reading and improving in data
```{r}
#Reading
Ctd_Verticals_LJ=read.csv(paste0(base_dir,"CV_LeftJoin.csv"),,sep=",",header=T) #reading in df with copepod verticals information

Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Month=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Month.x
Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Year=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Year.x
Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Temp=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$T090C
Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Salinity=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$D.Salinity
Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Light=Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Par

nc <- nc_open("C:/Shreya/NARW Thesis/Data/ccb_bath.nc") #opening up the nc file
print(nc)   #printing variables, dimensions, units, and attributes

lon       <- ncvar_get(nc, "lon")         # reading in longitude data (length 197)
lat       <- ncvar_get(nc, "lat")         # reading in latitude data (length 116) 
elevation <- ncvar_get(nc, "elevation")   # reading in elevation data (197 x 116 matrix)

nc_close(nc) #closing the nc file

nc_df <- expand.grid(lon = lon, lat = lat) |> #create df of nc file information
  mutate(
    elevation = as.vector(elevation),   #negative values are below sea level
    depth_m   = -elevation              # flip sign so there are positive readings of depth below surface
  )

df_ocean <- nc_df |>
  filter(elevation < 0) |>   #filtering out positive elevation to only get sea depth information 
  mutate(depth_m = -elevation)   #positive meters below sea level to have positive depth values 

RW_Sightings=read.csv(paste0(base_dir,"RW_Sightings.csv"),sep = ",",header=T)


#Improving
#Making time an integer
Lightsed=strptime(Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S") #making time a workable object 
Ctd_Verticals_LJ$time_of_day=Lightsed$hour*3600 + Lightsed$min*60 + Lightsed$sec #converting time to seconds of the day 

Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Month=as.factor(Ctd_Verticals_LJ$Month) #Making month a factor

Ctd_Verticals_LJ = Ctd_Verticals_LJ %>% #creating a column of max depth for each station
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(max_depth = max(sample.depth..m., na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```
